description: Hand-written questions for the synthetic sample documents (scripts/make_sample_docs.py). Expected sources are given by filename and page so they survive re-generation of the PDFs.

questions.question: What minimum attendance is required to write the end-semester examination?
Can a student with 70% attendance get condonation?
questions.answer: Yes, students with attendance between 65% and 75% may apply for condonation on medical grounds with a medical certificate.

questions.question: How much is the condonation fee?
Within how many days must the medical certificate be submitted?
questions.answer: Within 7 days of returning to classes.

questions.question: What happens if attendance is below 65%?
questions.answer: The student is not eligible for condonation and must re-register for the course.

questions.question: What are the conditions for eligibility to write end-semester exams?
questions.answer: Satisfy attendance, have no pending library dues, and register through the student portal before the deadline.

questions.question: How are the 40 internal marks distributed?
What are the pass criteria for a theory course?
questions.answer: At least 40% in the ESE and 50% in the aggregate of CIE and ESE.

questions.question: What is the penalty for late project submission?
questions.answer: 10% of the project marks per week of delay.

questions.question: What does the grade distribution chart show as the most common grade?
What topics are covered in Unit 3 of CS201?
questions.answer: Binary trees, traversals, binary search trees, AVL trees and rotations, heaps and priority queues.

questions.question: Which shortest path algorithm is taught in the graphs unit?
What is the prerequisite for Data Structures?
How many lab experiments must be completed to sit the lab exam?
What is the last date to apply for B.Tech admission?
Which documents must be produced at admission?
questions.answer: Class 10 and 12 mark sheets, transfer certificate, community certificate if applicable, two photographs, fee payment proof, and photo ID.

questions.question: When do the hostel gates close?
When are visitors allowed in the hostel?
questions.answer: Only on Sundays between 10 AM and 5 PM.

questions.question: Compare the project submission deadline in the regulations and the admission notice.
questions.answer: Regulations: two weeks before end-semester exams. Admission notice: 15 April 2027. The two documents state it differently.

questions.question: What is the hostel fee for international students?
Who is the faculty advisor of the robotics club?
What is the scholarship amount for merit students?
When is the annual sports day?
What is the placement record of the CSE department?
